name: freelook
description: The detached world camera, and the fixed vantages that stand on it. `freelook` is staff-only: it opens the GLASS renderer over any map_world tile with no vehicle under it, so the city can be looked at from anywhere instead of only from a cab, a cockpit or a wheelhouse. `telescope` is the same camera bolted down — furniture carrying flags.telescope is a place you stand, with mouse-look, WASD and a leash you cannot walk off, at an eye height the renderer owns rather than the server. One plugin because there is one camera-over-a-tile on the wire: one viewer set, one sky push, one close.

telescope.note: Surfaced by the declaration-only specialized action registered under requiredFlag telescope, so examining the instrument advertises TELESCOPE. The verb itself self-resolves the vantage in the room.
